tests.scope: Synthetic CPU points/tensors and a 16-particle synthetic model test only; no official arrays, checkpoint deserialization, CUDA or remote process launch by reviewer.

checks: Pinned unchanged five-file native core and separate graph-adapter bytes checked before importing the model helpers.

Default benchmark invocation describes only; actual execution requires explicit root-selected inputs, GPU UUID and fresh output. Root must supply the documented600-second outer process timeout and cleanup.

The pinned inspection report binds one first training record, N9271/T301/D3, metadata and official parser; arrays are byte/shape/dtype checked and rehashed at completion. No whole-source or whole-dataset checksum admission is claimed.
D3 radius.025, node37/edge4 feature dimensions, three-dimensional normalization and six-frame target6 construction follow the unchanged native builder.

Native directed capped graph/order is a mandatory prefix. Optional annulus pairs are canonical, sampled with independent NumPy RNG, appended symmetrically with exact floor(.25*annulus_count) budget when forcedexpanded25, and cannot cross batch examples.
The2Mexpanded-radius candidate-pair check precedes native neighbor materialization.5Mbatch directed-edge guard precedes encoder/processor execution on supplied graph.
Noise uses CPU-private twice-integrated velocity increments and kinematic type3 masking; the fixed batch/noise are reused in both cases and all updates.
D3 Gaussian NLL uses squared vector residual/(2q)+1.5logq; vector risk is3q. Faithful mean gradient equals MSE gradient with detached variance inputs. Analytical tests and native-forward parity pass.

Two fresh models receive the same hashed initialization and empty Adam. Each case has one warmup and three measured updates, eight total. Timing includes transfer/graph/forward/backward/Adam/checks/diagnostics/synchronization and excludes initialization/report IO as explicitly stated.
Finite forward, loss, gradient and parameter checks guard the benchmark update. Peak CUDA memory and per-update graph evidence are retained; no checkpoint is written or promoted.

nonblocking_findings.detail: Exactly one self edge wording is too strong after native capping: source-ID tie ordering can exclude self for coincident particles with degree>128. Actual implementation and130-coincident-particle test correctly preserve native cap/order. Interpret it as one self candidate before capping; no change to numeric behavior requested.

limits: This is one fixed first-record state duplicated into a batch, with fixed noise and only three measured updates per case; it cannot estimate full-cohort runtime or scientific efficacy.
Forcedexpanded25 is not the probabilistic mix training distribution. If the recorded optional budget is zero, timing is not evidence of expanded-graph throughput.
No GPU execution, actual first-record array validation, memory feasibility or600-second completion guarantee is established by this source review.
The benchmark checks finite parameters after Adam but is not the full scientific endpoint/optimizer audit. No scientific model or dataset admission follows automatically.
